name: flipside-design
provenance: Recommended adaptation tokens derived from visual inspection, not recovered original source values.

material.usage: Grain, tilt and cut ranges apply only when the chosen material and construction call for them. Keep continuous reading and quantitative axes aligned.

motion.reducedMotion: Replace large transforms and parallax with immediate changes or short opacity transitions. Preserve content and controls.
motion.design: Track content identity through a constrained action and a visible consequence. Determine axis, contact, overlap, shadow and final state before timing.

usage: Choose concept, composition, form hierarchy and coherent lighting before applying these optional values. Numerical values remain task-dependent.

form.structure: Support and reading surfaces use stable planes and visible thickness appropriate to the object.
form.curvature: Rotation, touch, flow and flexible materials determine useful curves.
form.edgeTreatment: Choose contour curvature, bevel, cut, fold and shadow softness independently according to construction.

light.direction: Choose a coherent main direction per scene.
light.volume: Coordinate lit planes, shaded planes, cast shadows and contact shadows.
light.material: Differentiate broad matte light, concentrated metal accents and thin sheet edges.
light.focus: Arrange contrast and quiet reading planes around the principal content.
